movelist.name: Slam
movelist.effect: Slam may be used as a Free Action at the end of a Sprint Maneuver taken as a Standard Action, as long as the user Shifted at least 3 meters in a straight line towards the target. When used this way, Slam gains the Smite keyword.

movelist.name: Mean Look
movelist.effect: The user casts a foul spell on the target, causing it to become Trapped and Slowed for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Hex
movelist.effect: Once a Scene, if Hex’s target has a Status Affliction, you may have Hex’s Damage Base be 13 instead (4d10+10 / 35).

movelist.name: Crafty Shield
movelist.effect: If the user or an Ally within 2 meters of Crafty Shield’s user is hit by a Status Move, you may use Crafty Shield as an Interrupt. All targets in Crafty Shield’s area- of-effect including the user, are instead not hit by the triggering Move and do not suffer any of its effects.

movelist.name: Disable
movelist.effect: Disable may be used as a Free Action that does not take up a Command whenever the user is hit by a Move. That Move becomes Disabled for the attacker.

abilities.name: Wandering Spirit
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee attack
abilities.effect: The user exchanges Wandering Spirit with a random Ability of the opposing Pokémon, as per the Move Skill Swap.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Execute Keyword. If a single source of Damage or Hit Point Loss would cause the user to lose more than X Hit Points, the damage or Hit Point loss is instead reduced to X. X is equal to 50% of their Max Hit Points. Defensive.
